title: Ninja Nutri-Plus Personal Blender, 900PW, (3) 20oz Cups, Silver, BN301 | 900-peak-watt push-to-blend motor for smoothies & sauces. (3) 20-oz cups, 2 spout lids & storage lid. Dishwasher safe.

reviews.title: Reliable and Powerful Amazing Blender!
reviews.body: I originally purchased this product to make smoothies, but it turned out to be much more versatile than I expected. I’ve been using it regularly for over six months now, and it has become a permanent part of my kitchen routine.When the product arrived, it was well-packaged and securely protected. The first impression was very positive. The materials feel solid and well-made. Visually, the product looks exactly like the photos shown on the listing, which I appreciated.In daily use, I haven’t had any issues with setup or operation. It’s very easy to use, and the blade is much sharper than I anticipated. I’m honestly careful not to touch it directly because it feels extremely sharp. I use it around two to three times a week, mostly for smoothies but also for sauces and quick food prep. Overall, the performance has been excellent.One of the biggest advantages is that it comes with multiple containers. This is very convenient, especially when preparing larger portions or when I don’t want to wash a container immediately. The containers are dishwasher-safe, which makes cleanup easy. I’ve washed both the blades and containers in the dishwasher many times, and there has been no dulling or visible wear. The blade handles ice easily and blends very efficiently. It really feels powerful for its size.As a small note, this is not really a negative, but the blade is extremely sharp, so extra care is needed when washing it by hand. Because of the sharp blade, I would say this product is better suited for adults, and children should only use it under supervision.Overall, I think this product is well worth the price. It performs better than I expected and has become a very useful kitchen tool for me.
reviews.date: Reviewed in the United States on December 31, 2025
reviews.author: Sunny F

reviews.title: Excellent personal blender!
reviews.body: I have only ever owned a ninja blender that has a ton more fancy options.  This is my first personal blender.  I am extremely pleased by it!  It is super easy to clean. This one comes with extra cups and lids. I have only cut fruit to make smoothies. It is super fast and does a very fine cut. You barely push down for it to activate and it is not super loud. No buttons!! Super easy to clean if you spill anywhere! Takes up barely more space on the counter to a comparable typical coffee cup.  I am extremely pleased with this blender. I highly recommend it if you want fast and easy blending and dont care about all the customizable options of dicing and things.  If you want it to not cut as fine, just pay attention and stop blending really fast because it is FAST!  like in 10 seconds I have a liquefied smoothie.  Thanks Ninja!

reviews.author: Sel

reviews.title: Powerful Motor, Blends Easily
reviews.body: This Ninja blender works beautifully.  I’ve blended smoothies from frozen fruit and ice and it blended completely in under a minute.  The motor is powerful. It’s convenient to be able to blend a smoothie into the same container to drink from so there’s only one to clean. That’s one reason why I bought this blender despite having a Vitamix (very old.) The Vitamix is great but it takes up too much storage space in my tiny kitchen and there are two containers to cleanup when making a smoothie. I plan to sell the Vitamix because the Ninja meets my blending needs. I just hope the Ninja has the longevity of the Vitamix.

reviews.title: Great little blender
reviews.body: I bought this mini blender to make my morning protein drink. I got the push to blend variety. It's compact, takes up very little space on the counter, yet at 700 watts, is quite powerful. It's easy to use & easy to clean. I have not had it for long, so cannot attest to it's durability, but suspect if used appropriately, it will last a long time. With the three provided cups & lids there's enough for a family. All the components are well designed and well made. I am very pleased with the purchase and consider it a good value.

reviews.body: I’m giving this four stars because when I put my cup down to blend It shakes pretty bad. And it’s very loud and shakes all over the table or whatever I’m blending on. I do like the ease of it because I can put everything in the cup. Blend it up and drink it and not have a big old mess to clean up afterwards. The blades seem pretty sharp and I think overall it’s a decent blender. Just wished it didn’t shake really bad. And it wasn’t so loud. I don’t think it’s supposed to shake like it does, but I can’t send it back now. Hopefully it’ll last at least a year.

reviews.title: Powerful Upgrade: My Experience with the Ninja Blender
reviews.body: After years of using my Magic Bullet, I decided it was time for an upgrade and chose a Ninja blender because I’ve always known Ninja to be a higher-quality brand. One of the main reasons I switched was that I wanted a larger cup size so I could make bigger smoothies without having to split them into multiple batches. The price of this blender also felt very fair for the quality and brand reputation, which made the decision even easier.One thing I really appreciate about this blender is how straightforward it is to use. There is essentially no assembly required and no complicated buttons to figure out. You simply screw the blade topper onto the cup, place it onto the machine, and press down to start blending. The only downside to this design is that you can’t operate it hands-free—you do have to hold it in place while it blends. That said, it works incredibly fast. It didn’t even take a full minute to completely blend frozen fruit, ice, and the other ingredients in my smoothie.Another feature I liked is that this set came with three cups and multiple lids, including tops that make it easy to drink your smoothie on the go. Having the extra cups is convenient if you’re making drinks for more than one person or prepping ahead. Overall, I’m really happy with this purchase and feel like it was a worthwhile upgrade from my Magic Bullet.

features: POWERFUL BLENDING: The intuitive 900-peak-watt push-to-blend motor base powers through everything inside the cup to give you the best of Ninja blending.

PRO EXTRACTOR BLADES ASSEMBLY: Easily crushes ice and breaks down whole fruits and veggies to create nutrient extractions*. *Extract a drink containing vitamins and nutrients from fruits and vegetables
BLEND TO-GO: Blend directly in one of the three included 20 oz. Ninja To-Go Cups and then twist on a Spout Lid to enjoy. Twist on a Storage Lid to store your creations.
PUSH-TO-BLEND: Manually pulse to easily crush ice, seeds & frozen ingredients.
DISHWASHER SAFE PARTS: Cups, lids, and blade assembly are top-rack dishwasher safe.
